name: Golden Frostbound Oath
passiveDesc: Increase DEF by 16/20/24/28/32%. When the equipping character's Elemental Skill or Lunar-Crystallize attacks hit opponents, gain the Frost Fae's Favor effect for 6s: Geo DMG inflicted by the equipping character increases by 40/50/60/70/80%, Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by 40/50/60/70/80%. While this effect is active, if there are Moondrifts near the equipping character, all other nearby party members will gain the Frost Fae's Mischief effect: Geo DMG dealt increases by 20/25/30/35/40% and Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by 20/25/30/35/40%. This effect can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
description: A longbow carved from ancient whitewood, once, in ages past, wielded by the Jack Frost King of the northern lands.
